title: inventory/assets/devices.json
description: Device list built from inventory/prod.json. software_version is the observed train from the topology map or SoT. product_id stays null until the operator types a Cisco PID. Lifecycle does not write this file.

node_definition.description: CML node type copied from prod.json. Not a Cisco PID.

serial.description: Optional label. Not a lookup key.

product_id.description: Cisco PID the operator typed. Null until set. Lifecycle looks this up.

software_version.description: Version observed on the box, from inventory/topology-observed.json or inventory/infra-sot.json. Not a Cisco recommendation.
